observations: ColorOS renders AOD clock, date and battery in a captured frame.
DreamManager and DisplayManager report DOZE_SUSPEND during an uninterrupted screen-off observation.
The owner confirms that the physical panel remains black.
The retained Xiaomi displayfeature AIDL and MiHwcExtension services are present.
A direct low-AOD-brightness request reaches the panel driver but its DSI command fails with crtc0 disable skip mtk_ddic_dsi_send_cmd_with_lock.

reference_source.purpose: Read the panel AOD command path and documented doze brightness enum. This reference does not establish the running kernel's build provenance.

bounded_tests.change: Request the documented low AOD brightness value 2 while in DOZE_SUSPEND.
bounded_tests.result: Panel command failed because the CRTC was disabled; owner saw no clock.

bounded_tests.change: Temporarily keep the display controller on, then request low AOD brightness.
bounded_tests.result: Owner saw no clock and reported a yellow artifact near the top.

bounded_tests.change: Request 30 Hz through the non-persistent user-preferred-mode API.
bounded_tests.result: Effective mode remained 120 Hz; the guard aborted before sending the brightness command.

bounded_tests.change: Temporarily apply an atomic 30 Hz display-mode request, verify active hardware mode, then request low AOD brightness.
bounded_tests.result: The hardware mode was verified at 30 Hz; the owner still saw a black screen.

next_step: Trace the stock Xiaomi video-panel AOD sequence, including displayfeature/MiHwcExtension calls and layer metadata, before another implementation attempt.
